title: Women’s Celebration of Pramukh Swami Maharaj
description: A celebration honoring Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the fifth spiritual successor of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and a beloved spiritual leader who inspired millions worldwide with his selfless service and devotion.
long_description:
A celebration honoring Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the fifth spiritual successor of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and a beloved spiritual leader who inspired millions worldwide with his selfless service and devotion. The program includes prayers, tributes, and cultural presentations.

This celebration takes place at BAPS Cleveland in Cleveland, OH. All are welcome.
